text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ............"Shoulder massages."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-I see!? My dad always gets happy when I 
give him a shoulder massage, 
and it has an element of surprise, so 
maybe it's not a bad idea...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Though it might not be quite suitable for 
small children. 
I'd prefer something that could bring joy 
to as many people as possible.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. 'Fan service' is... quite 
difficult."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Don't overthink it so much, let's keep an 
open mind, shall we? 
Like, tracing it back from 'the joyful 
smiles of the fans.'"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Deriving the 'why' from memories of when 
the fans were happy, right?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Memories of when they were happy...

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Lady
text_block_list.text:
"My heart was pounding just watching you! 
Show us plenty more of your running next 
year too!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Next time I'll make sure to win and 
turn it into a real festival!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Well? Did anything come to mind?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of things that make people 
happy, how about autographs? It's a 
classic! 
Chatting while signing is fun, and 
everyone looks so happy!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that sounds great! 
Maybe we could wear our racing silks too!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Impressive. Expanding ideas like that 
from 'fun' and 'happy'..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, coming up with festive ideas is 
kind of my specialty.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, that works out well. 
I've practiced my autograph for a long 
time."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haah—!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Whoa!? What amazing penmanship!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"My father, who made his name in the 
sports world— 
his autograph brought joy to many."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
As one who follows in his footsteps, 
knowing how to sign autographs is only 
natural.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, then our event is decided.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! Let's make this autograph session 
super exciting!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"So, about the countdown party event, 
we're doing a café, right?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Heh-heh~n♪ Not just any café, though! A 
super sparkly, VIP-style one that'll make 
the fans' hearts race~!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: A-A VIP café...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Picture it, Cheval! 
The lights shining through the Dubai 
night, illuminating us—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Dressed in luxury brand dresses~! 
Chatting with everyone just like we're at 
a grand gala~!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I want them to soak up the rich atmosphere 
in the ultimate celebrity setting~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"(Gaaah...! Just imagining it is 
embarrassing...! 
Normally, I'd absolutely decline something 
like that, but...)"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Well? Pretty good, right!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"... ...Y-Yeah. 
I'm... fine with that..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, really? Hmm... Alright, let's get the 
ball rolling then. 
Now then—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"—Thank you as always for your assistance. 
There are a few items I'd like to arrange, 
if that's alright?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, her go-to department store rep~. 
Having such a powerful big sis really is 
the best~!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"—Yes, using a projector to display the 
Dubai night skyline in the background... 
So I'll need the largest screen 
available..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Excuse me? It's currently rented out...? 
You only have the second-largest one...? 
...Understood. In that case, I will look 
elsewhere for the time being."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ugh... 'Second' is simply unbearable...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Huh~? The curse of '2nd place' again?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry. I am an Umamusume who stands 
at the pinnacle. 
I will secure the largest one, without 
fail."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"More importantly, shall we go look at 
outfits now? 
We can refine our vision as we choose."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of dress do you wanna wear, 
Cheval? 
We definitely gotta match as the three 
sisters~!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I'll leave it to you two.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Okey-doke! Then let's glam it up 
together! 
I wonder what we should dress Cheval in~?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"(Ugh, this is turning into something 
huge... but I have to do my best. 
If it can... make the fans even a l-little 
bit happy...)"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"(Those two are way better at fan service 
than me anyway... 
I should probably... just do what they 
say, right...?)"
